# Behance

> Behance is Adobe's creative platform connecting designers, artists, and creative professionals with job opportunities, portfolio showcasing, and community engagement.

Behance serves as a central hub for creative professionals to display their work, discover design trends, and connect with hiring opportunities. The platform integrates with Adobe Creative Cloud and offers subscription features through Behance Pro for portfolio monetization and career acceleration.

## Key Topics

- Portfolio Gallery
- Freelance Jobs
- Graphic Design
- Logo Design
- Behance Pro
- Adobe Integration
- Freelance Hiring
- Packaging Design
- Digital Art
- Design Portfolio
- Typography
- Editorial Design
- Best of Behance
- Creative Community
- Project Showcase

## Core Platform

- [Search Projects](https://www.behance.net): Behance homepage showcasing creative projects across design, branding, and visual arts
- [About Behance](https://www.behance.net/about): About page explaining Behance platform, community, and monetization opportunities
- [Blog](https://www.behance.net/blog): Design trends, community features, and artist spotlights from Behance

## Freelance & Hiring

- [Find Creative Jobs](https://www.behance.net/joblist): Job marketplace for creative freelance opportunities and career positions
- [Hire Freelance Designers](https://www.behance.net/hire): Freelance designer marketplace for hiring UI/UX, branding, and graphic design talent
- [Create Project Flow](https://www.behance.net/hire/createProjectFlow): Hiring flow interface for creating freelance projects and AI-powered recommendations

## Professional Growth

- [Behance Pro](https://www.behance.net/pro): Behance Pro subscription with portfolio tools, job access, and earnings growth features
- [Adobe Creative Apprenticeship](https://www.behance.net/resources/commissions): Adobe Creative Apprenticeship Program and commissioned project opportunities

## Community & Policies

- [Community Guidelines](https://www.behance.net/misc/community): Platform safety policies, content guidelines, and acceptable use standards

## Optional: Featured Projects

- [Corktown](https://www.behance.net/gallery/188127601/Corktown): Featured urban design project portfolio showcasing residential development in Hamilton
- [Pizzeria Alberico](https://www.behance.net/gallery/187955675/Pizzeria-Alberico): Brand identity and logo design case study for Boulder Neapolitan pizzeria
- [La Deseada](https://www.behance.net/gallery/180444857/La-Deseada): Coffee shop branding and packaging design project from Madrid
- [FROZEN COLORS OF WINTER – Germany](https://www.behance.net/gallery/188728551/FROZEN-COLORS-OF-WINTER-Germany): Fine art landscape photography portfolio by Jan Erik Waider from Germany
- [Chile, from Atacama to Patagonia](https://www.behance.net/gallery/187924485/Chile-from-Atacama-to-Patagonia): Travel and landscape photography portfolio from Chile by Jennifer Esseiva
- [Handmade Greyscalegorilla Plus](https://www.behance.net/gallery/187263329/Handmade-Greyscalegorilla-Plus): 3D art and advertising portfolio for Greyscalegorilla Plus product launch
- [Various Illustrations 2023–2024](https://www.behance.net/gallery/189936025/Various-Illustrations-2023-2024): Commercial and editorial illustration portfolio by Denis Freitas
- [Just My Type](https://www.behance.net/gallery/179194581/Just-My-Type): Typography and type design exploration by Studio MUTI
- [WELCOME TO MY WORLD](https://www.behance.net/gallery/188715837/WELCOME-TO-MY-WORLD): Abstract 3D art and digital design portfolio with vibrant color compositions
- [Free Illustration Vol.1](https://www.behance.net/gallery/186342897/Free-Illustration-Vol1): Free illustration collection by Estudio Pum from Barcelona
